description: Delete a post that has not been published — a draft, a scheduled post (its schedule goes with it) or one whose every channel failed. Its own stored images are deleted too; a linked product's photos are never touched. Refused for a post that went out on any channel: that record stays. This cannot be undone. Echoes the workspace.

id.description: The publication id returned by create_content_post or list_content_posts.

name: delete_content_post
title: Delete post
